tools.name: search
tools.description: Cited Bitcoin coordination index. Not a live quote, ETF, derivatives, or chain analytics. Pin a layer with source. If ok is false, the index has no passage. Every plan searches both layers. Footnotes label domain (protocol, lightning, mining, tooling, security, nostr, governance). Record: IRC review

tools.name: assess_argument
tools.description: Match the claim to a discourse game, numbered claim, or monopoly fallacy from Bitcoin_Discourse_Games, Bitcoin_Governance_Complete_Argument_Map, or Bitcoin_Core_The_Biggest_Fallacies. Return kind + heading pattern + cites. No new synthesis. These files are product policy (internal), not contemporane

tools.name: get_contributor_profile
tools.description: Public-record facts for a GitHub login, or that login's unique public GitHub name, from research findings. Known set is small (canonical maintainers). Most logins return found=false. Do not invent employment or affiliation.

tools.name: get_passage
tools.description: Return the stored index passage for a search cite. Pass id from the cite, or source plus doc. Not a live web fetch. If ok is false, the index has no passage.

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Replay a stored dated report. Free. Does not re-search or re-judge. A new as_of is a new call of the original tool.

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Score whether a stored index passage supports a claim. Pass id from a search cite, or source plus doc. Loads the stored excerpt then returns noul 0-1, skipped if the judge is unavailable, or no_passage if the index has no excerpt. Not a live web fetch. The judge is not a source.

tools.name: analyze_pr
tools.description: PR review scaffold for a public GitHub PR. Fetches filenames and a 4000-char patch pack, plus a capped live thread. Private repos fail. Precedent from the index. Does not post comments.

tools.name: analyze_issue
tools.description: Issue review scaffold for a public GitHub issue. Live-fetches title, body, and a capped comment thread. Private repos fail. Precedent from the index. Does not post comments.

tools.name: analyze_submission
tools.description: Advisory spec-versus-submission check. Retrieves cited index passages, then a closed judge label: met, not_met, or ambiguous. Empty index pack is ambiguous. Optional public GitHub PR (github_pr) is packed; private repos fail. Not a merge, payout, or money check. Does not post comments.

tools.name: find_discourse
tools.description: Retrieve GitHub, mail, IRC, and Delving cites for a path or symbol. Mail/IRC rarely include paths.

tools.name: find_precedent
tools.description: Retrieve BIP, GitHub, and mail cites for a proposal. Disposition is only what a cite heading or URL already says. Does not invent merged/rejected/stalled labels.

tools.name: find_incident
tools.description: Retrieve index cites for a named incident or CVE (e.g. CVE-2018-17144). Same search page as search. Empty if the index has no passage.

tools.name: find_spec_impl
tools.description: Retrieve spec, Core source, and GitHub cites for a spec section or behavior. Cites only. Does not emit aligned/gap/divergence verdicts.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search" is 1432 chars, far longer than this server's median (173). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, analyze_submission, find_precedent · Private data: search, assess_argument, get_contributor_profile, analyze_pr, analyze_issue, analyze_submission · Public sink: analyze_pr, analyze_issue, analyze_submission.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, analyze_submission, find_precedent · Private data: search, assess_argument, get_contributor_profile, analyze_pr, analyze_issue, analyze_submission · Public sink: analyze_pr, analyze_issue, analyze_submission

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
